findings.layer: S2/Price 42:15437 with S2/Price/4-mask 42:15440 and S2/Price/8-mask 42:15442; S2/Dim line 42:15368
findings.problem: The hero price collides with the dimension line. The build differs from the spec. S2/Price sits at x 600 (spec: 1003 − Σw = 703). The masks sit at x 0/120/240 (spec: x_{i+1} = x_i + w_i = 0/92/192). As a result the terracotta dimension line (screen x ≈ 620–629) runs straight through the vertical bar of the '$' (verified in design/price-dimline-f165.png). '$48' is also tracked loosely: there are 40–50 px gaps, so it reads '$ 4 8'. Its right edge is about 955 when it should be on the 1016 margin, so the price, the specs and '32 cm' share no column edge. This is on the product frame's money line, in the hold where the eye inspects it.
findings.fix: No keyframe changes are needed; the TRANSLATION_Y and blur keys live on the text nodes. 1. Move S2/Price (42:15437) x 600 → 703 (y stays 790, width stays 326). 2. Set S2/Price/4-mask (42:15440) x 120 → 92 and S2/Price/8-mask (42:15442) x 240 → 192. The '$' ink then starts at screen x ≈ 716, about 90 px clear of the line, and the '8' text box ends exactly on x 1016, sharing the right margin with 'Hand-thrown'. 3. Re-check f165 and f177 for clearance against '32 cm' (640–724, y 1083), which should keep ≥ 25 px.

findings.problem: The offer reads 'IO%'. Cormorant Garamond SemiBold renders old-style figures: the '1' renders 154 px tall at 400 px, which is x-height, and is an unflagged I-shape with symmetrical serifs. The '0' sits at x-height while the '%' is at full height. The hero therefore reads as small caps 'IO' next to a big '%', and on f290-f292 the '1' rises alone as a bare 'I'. The same thing happens at 60 px on the end card ('ıo% off'). This is the single most important line of the ad. Lining figures cannot be switched on through the tool, because openTypeFeatures is read-only in the Plugin API (plugin-api.d.ts:9774).
findings.fix: Set the numerals in the second family, which has lining figures. 1. Set S5/Ten/1, /0 and /% to Inter Semi Bold 300, LH 480 (unchanged, so the masks and the TRANSLATION_Y 480 keys stay valid), LS −4 %. 2. Re-measure and set each mask width to w_i + 52. The row is FIXED 952 CENTER, so it re-centres itself. 3. Nudge S5/Ten y (380 → about 398) so the baseline stays at screen 747, checked with absoluteRenderBounds. 'off' and 'your first order.' stay in Cormorant Medium Italic: a sans numeral against serif italic is a deliberate contrast and still uses only two families. 4. On the end card, set S4/10% off (42:15491) to Inter Semi Bold 50, re-measure w1, then recompute x1 = (952 − (w1 + 16 + w2))/2 − 8 and the 'your first order' mask x. Alternative if Cormorant must stay: replace the '1' and '0' text nodes with hand-drawn lining-figure vectors at cap height (about 225 px), keeping the same keys.

findings.time: 10.23-11.00 (f307-f330), worst at the punch f306-f310 and through the breath
findings.problem: The hand-drawn loop cuts through the lower-right bowl of the '%' at screen (800-830, 705-740). This was verified at the punch peak f308 and in the breath f318 (design/loop-pct-f308.png, design/loop-pct-f318.png). The baked tilt pulls the loop's lower-right in, the 1.06 punch on S5/Ten pushes the '%' into it, and the ROTATION drift 0 → 2° (counter-clockwise) lifts the right side further. Its bottom also sits only about 15-25 px above the 'ff' ascenders. A circled offer has to clear its figures; on a static breath this crossing reads as a mistake.
findings.fix: 1. Add SCALE_XY on the S5/Loop wrapper (42:16198), pivot = its centre (540, 621): @0 1.10,1 · @14.4 1.10,1 L, or 1.14,1 if the Inter figures are adopted. Widen it, not heighten it, so it does not hit 'off'. 2. Reverse the drift on S5/Loop path (42:16199) ROTATION: @0 0 · @9.8 0 L · @11.1667 −2 L, so it turns clockwise and the right side moves away from the '%'. 3. Re-cut f308 and f318 and confirm ≥ 20 px clearance to the '%' bowl and the 'ff' ascenders.

findings.problem: The kiln arch, the scene's signature shape, dissolves at the top. The mug photo's marble whites (about #f2ede7) and the bowl's white top sit on linen #f4efe7 with no visible edge (design/arch-top-f207.png). The plates shot is cool blue-white porcelain on terrazzo, a colour-temperature break from the warm stoneware palette and weaker brand fit.
findings.fix: 1. Add one RECT 'S3/Warm' 520 × 720 at (0, 0) inside S3/Window, above S3/Bowl, with fill #e9e1d6 and layer blend MULTIPLY (figma_set_blend_mode). This mirrors S2/Warm. It pulls the photo whites to about #e0d6c9, so the arch reads against linen, and it warms the plates. 2. Key it so the bloom seed still lands on a pure terracotta wall: OPACITY @0 1 · @9.0 1 L · @9.1667 0 SOFT.

findings.problem: The offer composition is top-heavy. The block spans y 413-1145 (centre about 780), while the safe area 250-1580 centres at 915. That leaves about 435 px of empty terracotta under 'your first order.' during the 1.1 s hold, when the frame is most scrutinised.
findings.fix: Move the four children of S5/Offer type down 70 px: S5/Ten y 380 → 450, S5/off-mask 800 → 870, S5/Line 1040 → 1110, S5/Loop 391 → 461. Keep every key, since the TRANSLATION_Y values are relative and the masks clip the falls.
